serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Lady Annalie: No! Stop taking your clothes off! I don’t want to see it! 
Random woman: Kyah!!!{{punch}}
Landlord: Is that the thing you want me to wear?! Isn’t that for a woman?! T-There’s been some kind of terrible mistake!
Lady Annalie: You already undressed and now you have second thoughts?! Just get it on! 
Landlord: I-Isn’t it a little too tight around my belly?
Lady Annalie: A little? I don’t even have enough spare fabric to add to the waist!
You: I see that you two are doing your best so I won’t disturb you…
Let’s find a good place in the crowd. The show is about to begin.
